name: Dashboard Product Next Steps Deck
title: Research Suggestions
subtitle: Evening Recap, Oct 13
intro: Today you Loved the dashboard product plan. These 9 next steps are still open for your votes. Ideas only; owners build after Max approves.

close.title: Send Your Picks
close.text: Tap Submit to send these answers to Research. Copy My Answers and Share still work. Older decks stay under Previous Decks.

cards.label: Stay Inside The Agent Platform Terms
cards.line: Grok Bot Terms (updated Oct 12, 2026) allow use for the customer's internal business purposes. The enterprise terms bar selling, renting or time-sharing the service.

source.title: Grok Bot Terms, sec. 1.1 Authorized Use

source2.title: Enterprise Terms: Permitted Users, Bundled Service

cards.next: Before any money changes hands, ask the provider in writing which model is allowed. This is not legal advice.

optionA.label: Client Owns The Account
optionA.desc: The client buys its own plan. Max sets it up as their outside consultant, which the enterprise terms list as a permitted user.

optionB.label: Build On The API
optionB.desc: Enterprise terms let end users reach the service only inside your own product (a Bundled Service). More to build first.

cards.label: Landing Page And Waitlist Tools
cards.line: Carrd Pro Standard is $19 a year with a custom domain and forms. Tally forms are free with unlimited submissions; Tally Pro is EUR 20 a month.
cards.next: Cheapest path: Carrd Pro Standard plus a free Tally waitlist form, price shown on the page.

cards.label: Which Name Do You Sell Under
cards.line: maxweberman.com already sits in the footer of every dashboard. A new brand needs a new domain, and a US trademark filing is $350 per class.
cards.next: Pick A or B. If B, run a name and trademark search before buying a domain.

optionA.label: maxweberman.com
optionA.desc: No new domain. Your name is the trust signal with contractors you already know.

optionB.label: A New Brand
optionB.desc: A separate name that can grow past you. Costs a domain, plus $350 per class to file a trademark.

cards.label: First Contractor Pilot Offer
cards.line: Contractors already pay $29 to $599 a month for Jobber. The plan's Founding Pilot is an Estimate to test: $750 setup plus $250 a month, 3 lanes, 3 spots.

source2.title: Stripe pricing: 2.9% + 30c per US card charge

cards.next: Write a one-page offer with clear cancel and refund terms. Take no money until private login is ready.

cards.label: Demo As A Phone Screen Recording
cards.line: iPhone records the screen from Control Center and saves it to Photos. One clip can show a Morning Report, one swipe and one vote.

source.title: Apple: Record the screen on your iPhone

cards.next: Research writes a shot list on example data only; Max records it on his phone.

cards.label: Onboarding Intake Questions
cards.line: The plan calls for a 20-minute intake before setup. Tally runs it free with unlimited submissions and sends answers to Google Sheets.
cards.next: Draft the questions; Max fills them in for his own business as the first test.

cards.label: QR Sheet For The Next Home Guide
cards.line: node-qrcode is MIT-licensed, outputs SVG and runs in the browser, so a new home guide can print its own sticker sheet with no paid QR service.
cards.next: Add it to the home guide template only. Niko's guide stays as it is.

cards.label: Keep The Address Lookup Free
cards.line: Google Places Autocomplete has 10,000 free requests a month, then $2.83 per 1,000. Sessions that end in Place Details bill at most 12 requests.
cards.next: Use session tokens and set a billing budget alert before the address step goes live.

cards.label: Hear The Word Before You Answer
cards.line: The browser speech API has worked across browsers since September 2018. Voices come from the device, so missed words can be read aloud for free.
cards.next: Check that Max's iPhone lists a Thai voice; show text only when it does not.
